findings.finding: The six-result limit hides an exact phenotype-name match; ext_ids are not searched.
findings.example: Searching Epileptic encephalopathy does not expose the existing new node hp_0200134. Searching HP:0100660 also fails to find Dyskinesia.
findings.proposal: Prioritize exact names/aliases, include existing ext_ids, and expose remaining results through pagination or expansion. P1 may add stable-ID synonyms within the existing field as a compatibility aid; this does not replace a fix for result truncation.

findings.finding: Inherited discovery-cluster memberships appear as unqualified functional assignments.
findings.example: Both the single-participant SCN2A GoF ASO study NCT06314490 and the SCN2A LoF mouse CRISPRa project 11289342 display both LoF and GoF clusters.
findings.proposal: Label these as provisional discovery groups and expose membership rationale. P2 should review whether research/PI memberships carry an unintended functional implication. Retain variant-specific assay evidence separately from broad-condition discovery links.

findings.finding: Study nodes show recorded status but omit retrieval date, next_step and the single-participant restriction.
findings.example: NCT06314490 displays active not recruiting without showing its one-pediatric-participant scope or 2026-10-03 retrieval date.
findings.proposal: Use existing props.plain/next_step/scope_note or display these existing fields. Suggested wording for this new node: A dated research record (retrieved 2026-10-03) for one pediatric participant with SCN2A-associated DEE. Recorded status: active not recruiting. This is an individualized research protocol, not a general enrollment opportunity. Cluster membership is a provisional discovery grouping, not a functional assignment.
findings.status: P1 text clarification complete; P3 rendering acceptance pending
findings.p1_resolution: Existing props.plain now states retrieval date, dated status and provisional discovery scope for the 15 added studies. NCT06314490 explicitly states its one-pediatric-participant scope and is not a general enrollment opportunity.

findings.finding: A failed names/synonyms search is presented as an absence of papers, trials, registries or patient groups.
findings.example: HP:0100660 shows No supported route and a Missing claim even though the Dyskinesia node and its evidence exist.
findings.proposal: Only report no matching name/alias within the slice. Distinguish no match, unsearched data and evidence-backed coverage gaps. If P4 coverage is displayed, retain its scope and source dates.

findings.finding: Structured field summaries and verbatim quotations share the same blockquote styling.
findings.example: The Dyskinesia frequency sentence combines Orphadata fields; NIH PI snippets may also combine fields. Provenance correctly records structured_record.
findings.proposal: Identify structured-record summaries explicitly; preserve raw fields and locators, and do not describe compositions as verbatim quotations.

findings.finding: Long labels overlap substantially in the 120-node graph, including focused searches.
findings.example: The tested 1280x900 desktop layout and initial 697px-wide view both show crowding. Detail panels remain readable.
findings.proposal: Consider labels only for selected nodes/direct neighbors, with hover text for other nodes. Verify long study titles and densely connected regions.

scope: Historical browser observations retained as handoff; current operation performs P1 review only and does not rerun P3 acceptance.
